sec.title: August 30 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 434)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 30** across American network radio and radio drama anthologies, the historic network premiere of *The Walter Winchell Show* on NBC Blue for Lucky Strike (1931), Larry Haines in *The Night Shift* on *CBS Radio Mystery Theater* (1976), Richard Kollmar as *Boston Blackie* solving a synthetic fuel formula murder (1950), Stacy Harris tracking syndicate gambling on *This Is Your FBI* (1946), Mutual broadcasting live from the 1940 New York World's Fair, and postwar veteran rehabilitation on *Treasury Salute* (1931–1976):
